##### Project general facts

Manchester City Residences by Ohana Development is a landmark football-branded waterfront community on Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, created in partnership with one of the most influential football clubs in the world - Manchester City. This is not a decorative branding exercise. The club’s philosophy, culture and lifestyle are embedded into the DNA of the project, shaping the environment, amenities, and everyday experience of residents.

The project is designed around the idea of performance, discipline, growth and belonging - the same values that define Manchester City on the global stage. Architecture, public spaces, landscapes and community planning reflect a balance between elite performance and refined lifestyle. The masterplan promotes movement, wellbeing, social connection and purpose-driven living through walkable layouts, generous green zones, waterfront promenades and thoughtfully designed communal areas.

Residents live inside an ecosystem where football culture is tangible. A globally branded Manchester City sports academy operates directly within the community, offering professional training programs, youth development pathways and authentic club methodologies. Signature sports facilities, interactive club-inspired spaces and curated experiences connect residents with the identity of Manchester City in a meaningful, daily way.

The residential offering includes waterfront apartments, townhouses, twin villas and expansive villas, each designed with contemporary aesthetics, functional layouts and a strong emphasis on comfort and quality of life. More than half of the development is dedicated to green landscapes, wellness areas and outdoor recreation, reinforcing the project’s core idea - a lifestyle built around health, energy, ambition and belonging to something globally significant.


##### Location description and benefits

Yas Canal represents one of the most refined waterfront environments on Yas Island, defined by open water views, architectural harmony and a sense of understated prestige. The canal shapes the atmosphere of the area, creating a calm, private and visually compelling residential setting while remaining fully connected to the island’s key destinations.

This location naturally supports the lifestyle concept of the project. Waterfront promenades, landscaped walkways and open green corridors encourage daily movement and outdoor living. Cafés, leisure spaces and pedestrian-friendly planning foster social interaction and a sense of community that aligns seamlessly with the philosophy of Manchester City - connection, belonging and shared identity.

Connectivity is effortless. Residents enjoy direct access to Yas Island’s major attractions, retail destinations, hospitality landmarks and cultural venues, while benefiting from the privacy and exclusivity of a canal-side environment. The area offers a rare balance between energy and tranquility.

With its freehold ownership options for international buyers, growing infrastructure, and strong rental demand, Manchester City Yas Residences A offers investors potential for capital growth, rental returns, and an exclusive lifestyle on Yas Island.
